src: 5x5 sprite s with one body color and one corner-marker control pixel
dst: corner 5x5 block d marked by a corner control pixel
transform: swap s.body_color and s.control_color in place; paint d with the visible overlay of all matched s.foreground masks using d.marker_color
multi_step: side control-pixel collisions take the visible matched body color at the same local cell; one-sprite vertical tails hidden between other matched masks are omitted from the corner overlay
